_about: Format of raw/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json, one file per trading session, written once by tools/postexit.py and never edited. Not served by Pages, but readable in this public repo. Prices are the underlying's unless a field says premium.

sources.webull_fills: count of Ty's fills that session
sources.bots_bundle: present | missing (Mac collector did not deliver)

bots.green_t: v7: when the trade reached +1R, or null
bots.stop_moves: v7: [{t, leg, role, old, new, move}]

skips.setup: v7 setup names, or the sweep order and arm time, or 'not armed'
skips.why: the bot's own reason, id-like tokens scrubbed
skips.first_hit: target | stop | neither | both in one minute | unknown (…), later that session

unparsed_exits.line: an EXIT line the parser did not match, scrubbed

after.candles: next 10 three-minute candles [t, open, high, low, close] after the exit or skip time
after.session_last: start of that day's last 3-minute candle
after.proxy: present only when the path is a proxy, e.g. 'SPY x 10' for SPX
